input_evidence: optical frames; thread status; state tags
message_or_update: send time tube, optical thread strength, target state tags, and boundary or competition tags
allowed_use: narrow SAR review space and preserve optical uncertainty
forbidden_use: SAR identity truth; final box; annotation permission; one-to-one mapping claim
expected_failure_mode: optical hypothesis too broad, too narrow, or competitor-contaminated
notes: Start with one GM_RM011 window only.

input_evidence: time metadata; runtime-safe geometry if available; optical state
message_or_update: convert optical hypothesis into feasible review field
allowed_use: review constraint and mechanism hypothesis field
forbidden_use: selected SAR box; GT-derived location; runtime prediction
expected_failure_mode: missing azimuth source or imprecise temporal alignment
notes: Feasible field is not final localization.

input_evidence: opened SAR evidence stage or posthoc-readable SAR morphology
message_or_update: report vehicle-scale structure, ridge, endpoint hotspot, weak opposite side, shell contour, or insufficient evidence
forbidden_use: final annotation; selected component; bright point equals vehicle
expected_failure_mode: isolated bright point or tiny component mistaken for vehicle

message_or_update: report non-jump drift, gradual drift, jump-like contradiction, or missing drift
expected_failure_mode: no traceable drift chain or frame mismatch
notes: Drift can support mechanism, not identity.

input_evidence: nearby non-target, outside-GT, background, road edge, static reflector, guardrail, or competitor region
message_or_update: test whether non-target region fails the same mechanism
allowed_use: reject background and close negative logic
forbidden_use: GT overlap alone as proof; background ignored
expected_failure_mode: no available contrast region or contrast also looks vehicle-like
notes: Absence of contrast keeps the state weak or missing-factor-exposed.

input_evidence: optical message; SAR response; temporal feedback; negative contrast
allowed_use: record support, contradiction, boundary preservation, background risk, or missing factor
expected_failure_mode: multiple states coexist and no single closure is justified
notes: Contradiction is an output, not an error.

message_or_update: revise optical hypothesis scope, uncertainty, boundary status, or missing-factor request
allowed_use: repair planning and next evidence request
forbidden_use: posthoc evidence copied into runtime prior
expected_failure_mode: feedback asks for forbidden GT-derived runtime construction

input_evidence: proposed mechanism and SAR GT-local reference
message_or_update: validate whether mechanism fits GT-local vehicle-scale structure
forbidden_use: factor definition; threshold definition; candidate selection
expected_failure_mode: GT-local fit is only a bright point or GT quality is questionable
notes: GT is not read until after mechanism proposal.

input_evidence: proposed mechanism and nearby non-target or outside-GT examples
message_or_update: validate that non-target regions do not satisfy the same mechanism
allowed_use: negative contrast check and leakage control
forbidden_use: GT-only proof; weak-thread upgrade from overlap
expected_failure_mode: negative examples unavailable or not discriminative
notes: Positive GT-local fit without contrast is insufficient.

message_or_update: record final loop state for the window
forbidden_use: final box; SAR-ready annotation; runtime prediction; identity truth
expected_failure_mode: mechanism remains weak, contradicted, boundary-blocked, or insufficient
notes: Useful outcomes include missing_factor_exposed and boundary_preserved.
